config_name: IdeaPad Slim 3i 15.3" IPS — Core 3 100U, 8GB, 512GB SSD, FHD IPS

specs.ports: 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen1, 1x USB-C 3.2 Gen1 (PD, DP), HDMI 1.4, 3.5mm
specs.webcam: 1080p FHD IR hybrid, dual mic, privacy shutter

battery.notes: Capacity not published on BBY spec; class norm 45-55Wh for this chassis. Core 3 100U is low-power; ~5-6.5h real.

offers.name: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3i 15.3" IPS Laptop - Intel Core 3 100U - 8GB - 512GB SSD - Windows - Luna Grey

reviews.quote: It's one of the cheaper 15.6-inch laptops you can find without resorting to used systems; a decent barebones experience so long as you keep your expectations in check.
Not going to set anyone's world on fire, but a great value for those that just need a Windows computer.
Sits just a rung or two above the minimum viable Windows laptop, held back by lackluster battery life and a limited raw-performance ceiling.

praises: 1080p FHD IR webcam with dual mics and privacy shutter is the best camera in this price bracket
IPS WUXGA panel with anti-glare is a clear step up over TN competitors at the same street price
Light 1.6 kg thin chassis still uses the newer slim 3i shell, not an old brick design
Windows Hello IR face unlock works out of the box — rare at $699 sale
Silent and cool during browsing, docs, and video streaming
complaints: Core 3 100U is the weakest CPU choice in the 3i line; heavier multitasking stutters with 8GB
RAM is soldered — 8GB is the permanent ceiling
Regular $1,199.99 price is poor; only makes sense at the $699 sale
Panel is dim (~300 nits) with the same washed 45%-gamut look as the rest of the line
Plastic deck flex and hinge wobble match the cheaper 3i models

standouts: IR face-unlock + 1080p webcam + IPS panel combo at $699 sale is a strong student pick
design_philosophy: An older Series 1 Core 3 refresh of the same thin 15.3" IdeaPad Slim 3i shell, sold alongside the newer Core 5 320 models at a lower street price. It trades a bit of CPU and iGPU punch for the same IPS WUXGA panel and the line's best webcam option (1080p IR with shutter).
rating_notes: No pro review found (bot-walls; see SHARED-ideapad-slim3.md). Inferred from Core 5 320 sibling: −0.4 productivity and −0.1 gaming for the weaker Core 3 100U. Battery capacity unpublished — 5.8h is a class estimate. Panel listed IPS by BBY naming; gamut assumed 45% NTSC class norm.
